d: Tune in to this all time hit song Didi Tera Devar Deewana sung by Lata Mangeshkar and S. P. Balasubrahmanyam from Rajshri Production's Blockbuster movie Hum Aapke Hain Kaun (1994) starring Salman Khan & Madhuri Dixit in the lead. Music composed by Raam Laxman. The other star cast includes, Mohnish Bahl, Renuka Shahane, Anupam Kher, Reema Lagoo, Alok Nath, Lakshmikant Berde. The movie is Directed by Sooraj.R. Barjatya.
